bodies:
70% of independent restaurants get rejected for traditional banks. Here's why—and what successful operators are doing instead.
The problem isn't your business. It's the collateral trap.
Banks lend against assets: buildings, equipment, inventory. But your restaurant's real value is in your brand, your reviews, your regulars—intangible assets banks can't underwrite.
Leasehold improvements? Zero liquidation value to a lender. Kitchen equipment? Depreciates 50% the moment it's installed. Your Yelp rating and Google reviews? Worthless on a loan application.
This is the $50K-$500K "Missing Middle" where viable businesses suffocate.
Honeycomb solves this by leveraging what actually matters: customer loyalty. Your regulars invest, earning interest while you get growth capital for patio build-outs that extend your season and second ovens to double throughput.
500+ businesses have raised $16M+ this way. Not charity—structured debt with fixed terms.
Check eligibility. See if community investment fits your growth plan.

The bank rejected your loan because your leasehold improvements "aren't bankable collateral." That's not a bug—it's the whole broken system.
Traditional lenders are built for real estate developers and manufacturers. They literally cannot underwrite the business model that makes independent restaurants successful.
Your $200K kitchen build-out? Attached to a landlord's building—worth $0 to Wells Fargo. Your 4.8-star Google rating? Not on the balance sheet. Your line around the block every Saturday? Banks don't have a checkbox for that.
Meanwhile, 39% of restaurants reported negative profitability in 2024—not because they're bad businesses, but because they're trapped in predatory financing or starved of growth capital.
Smart operators are bypassing the system entirely. Through Honeycomb, restaurants raise growth capital directly from their customer base. It's structured debt, not donations, but instead of paying interest to a faceless bank, you pay it to your best customers—who then spend it back at your restaurant.
See if you qualify. 2-minute pre-qualification. No credit impact.

Tired of watching 25% of your daily credit card sales disappear to an MCA?
You're profitable. Your regulars love you. But you're trapped in a predatory cycle that makes it impossible to breathe—let alone grow.
Every morning, before you pay rent or staff, the MCA takes its cut. One slow week and you're scrambling. Meanwhile, the bank still won't approve you because "restaurants are too risky."
There's a different path. Honeycomb lets your own customers invest in your business—turning their loyalty into your working capital. Restaurants use this to refinance high-cost MCAs at manageable rates, build that second location your community has been asking for, and upgrade equipment without giving up equity.
Unlike banks, we don't require real estate collateral. Unlike MCAs, we don't drain your cash flow daily.
See if you pre-qualify—takes 2 minutes, zero impact to your credit.

Planning a second location but the bank says you "lack sufficient collateral coverage"?
You already proved the concept works. Your first restaurant is profitable. Your customers are asking when you'll open closer to them. But traditional lenders won't count your future location's revenue toward debt service—meaning your existing spot needs to support debt for both units. That's mathematically impossible for most independents.
Here's what other restaurants are doing: Instead of begging banks, they're raising $25k-$300K directly from their existing customer base through Honeycomb Credit. Your regulars become investors, earning interest while you get the capital to expand.
The model works because social capital substitutes for physical collateral, your community wants you closer and they'll fund it, and investors become brand evangelists. 

Pre-qualify now. 2-minute form, no credit hit.

What if you could fund your restaurant expansion without adding another sleepless night worrying about debt payments?
You didn't open a restaurant to become a spreadsheet accountant. You did it for the craft, the community, the creative freedom.
But growth requires capital. And every financing option feels like a trap. Banks want your house as collateral. MCAs bleed you dry with daily deductions. Equity investors want control over your menu.
You need patient capital that matches how restaurants actually operate—seasonal, relationship-driven, margin-sensitive.
Honeycomb Credit lets you raise $25K+ from the people who already believe in you: your customers. Fixed monthly payments. 3-5 year terms. No daily sales deductions. No equity dilution.
Use it for equipment that increases capacity, renovations customers can see and enjoy, and second locations they've been requesting.
Pre-qualify in 2 minutes. See your eligibility without a credit check.
